description: konareef-local copy of the two PRD 4 §B.6.1 capture provisional-id vectors. They were in the pre-2026-06-10 upstream vector file and are absent from the current one. The provisional_id, logical_key and index fields do not depend on the tree hash and are still checked. expected_value_hash and expected_leaf_hash are the pre-swap SHA-256 values; they are kept for history and are NOT checked (the value hash is now Poseidon).
source: paygate-zk docs/prds/konareef-integration-contract-conformance-vectors-v1.json before the 2026-06-10 PRD 4 hash swap (mirrored into konareef testdata/vectors/v1.json on 2026-06-08)

vectors.description: Canonical provisional capture (PRD 4 §B.6.1): SHA-256(DTAG_PROV(0x22) || content_hash || be_u64(task_id) || be_u32(ordinal))[0:8] interpreted as be_u64. The vector pins byte-exact expected provisional_id, then chains the result as a thought_id through the B.1 derivation (logical_key, index, value_hash, leaf_hash) under SALT_A. Distinguishes a self-referential 'wantPID := ProvisionalID(...)' test from a genuine golden anchor.

Provisional reconciliation MUST reject when a claimed provisional_id does not equal the recomputed value (PRD 4 §B.6.1 fail-closed gate). The claimed value here is provisional_id+1 from capture-provisional-id-canonical; ReconcileProvisional(recomputed, claimed) MUST surface ERR_PROVISIONAL_ID_MISMATCH.
